_what_this_is: A TRANSCRIPTION, read off the page images of a public-domain professional quantity takeoff. Every item carries the leaf and the printed page it was read from. Nothing here is computed by BuildSmart and nothing here is inferred: a figure that could not be read with confidence is absent, and an absent figure makes the harness abstain. The imperial figures are the primary record; the metric values are an exact unit conversion (1 ft = 0.3048 m exactly, international definition 1959), not a measurement.

source.leaf_to_printed_page: leaf 343 = p.324, leaf 344 = p.325, leaf 345 = p.326; the plan plates are leaves 502-520, Plate 8 (Ground Plan) on leaf 516, Plate 6 (Section B-B) on leaf 512
source.ocr_warning: The _djvu.txt OCR of this work is UNUSABLE for the dimension-paper columns: the three-column waste/dimension/squaring layout does not survive text extraction. stated_conventions.our_frozen_choice: CEILING_IS_FLAT_AND_COINCIDENT_WITH_FLOOR = True; no cornice or chimney-breast deduction
stated_conventions.fletcher_rule: Measure the ceilings the full dimensions between the walls; but where cornices occur, it is customary to make a deduction of the width of the cornice upon each dimension for width and length of ceiling. ... Make the deductions for chimney breasts, &c.
stated_conventions.cited: p.128, leaf 147 (prose chapter, Plasterer — Internal Work)
stated_conventions.worked_example_in_source: a room 20'0" x 16'0" with a 12" cornice is booked 19'0" x 15'0" = 285 sq ft instead of 320 sq ft

stated_conventions.formula: F2 wall paintable area — the skirting band
stated_conventions.fletcher_rule: Rendering to walls is measured the length by the height, the latter being taken from the top of the skirting grounds to the ceiling, and where there is a cornice it is customary to deduct from this dimension half the height of the cornice.
stated_conventions.note: This is a DIRECT, CITED contradiction of the frozen choice, on the very term the frozen module placed outside the tolerance budget because it is worth ~4.0% at a 0.10 m skirting on a 2.50 m height. The frozen value is NOT revised; the divergence is recorded.

stated_conventions.formula: F2 wall paintable area — the opening deduction
stated_conventions.our_frozen_choice: WALL_PAINT_DEDUCTS_EVERY_STATED_OPENING = True, at the stated area
stated_conventions.fletcher_rule: In the case of deductions for doors and windows, take the full dimensions for length and height to the outside of the grounds, and not the net dimensions. In the case of doors, the height, where there is a skirting, must be taken from the top of skirting grounds, and not from the floor.
stated_conventions.note: Agrees that every opening is deducted, and specifies WHICH dimensions: the structural opening including grounds, not the clear opening. Our schema's P9 'opening area stated by the source' does not say which of the two it is, and this is the gap step 3 must close per project.

stated_conventions.our_frozen_choice: BASEBOARD_BREAKS_AT_DOOR_OPENINGS = True, full stated opening width deducted
stated_conventions.fletcher_rule_joiner: Skirtings. — Collect on 'Waste' the lengths of the several walls, making the deductions for doors, chimney-pieces, &c., and bring the total length of skirting to each room, forward in one dimension only.
stated_conventions.fletcher_rule_plasterer: Cement Skirtings. — Take the lengths and collect the same on 'Waste.' State the height, and bill and value at per foot run.
stated_conventions.agrees: THE TWO TRADES IN THE SAME BOOK DISAGREE
stated_conventions.observed_in_the_takeoff: On p.325 the cement skirting of ROOM_324B is booked at 35'6", which is the room's FULL collected girth, with the breaks numbered separately as 8 stopped ends, 2 mitres and 4 irregular. The joiner's prose rule would have deducted the three 2'10" door openings. OBSERVATION, not a settled claim: the trades differ and step 3 must match the trade before it matches the number.
stated_conventions.note: This is the contested convention the directive asks to be named as a choice. It is now contested on the page, not in the abstract.

stated_conventions.formula: F1 flooring purchase quantity — the wastage allowance
stated_conventions.our_frozen_choice: the wastage allowance is an INPUT with provenance, never a guess
stated_conventions.fletcher_rule: Where the room is irregular, it will be necessary to ascertain the average size of the flooring, so as to arrive at the net area, and make an allowance for all irregular cuttings, taking the length by a width of 3 in. for the cutting and waste.
stated_conventions.note: A cited professional precedent that a cutting-and-waste allowance is STATED as a rule with a dimension, not assumed as a percentage.
